description: An events office asks for a stand balance with five payment details in one message, then lists four of them again.

messages.text: Good morning, this is the events office about your stand at the spring trade fair.

To confirm your stand, please pay the balance of 1,250 GBP today. You can pay by card at https://pay.fair-stands.test/booking/7741 or by bank transfer to the account holder Sample Events Ltd, IBAN GB29 TEST 6016 1331 9268 19, quoting booking 7741. If you prefer a mobile wallet, send the amount to +44 7700 900417 instead. Once you have paid, call our bookings desk on +44 7700 900582 so that we can release the stand.
Thanks, I will pay this afternoon.

Here are the payment options again:
Card: https://pay.fair-stands.test/booking/7741
Bank transfer: Sample Events Ltd, account number 41234567
Mobile wallet: +44 7700 900417
The stand is released as soon as one payment arrives.
